integrity: Exact coefficient formulas and an algebraic normalization argument are supported by a standalone SymPy checker. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complex characteristic zero only; reduced singular support is determined, not the scheme-theoretic Jacobian singular structure or local analytic classification. General boundary equality is in the Chow group, not an ideal-sheaf decomposition. Historical priority is qualified.
title: The two-line singular boundary of the degree-seven octic composition threefold
